title: 2027 Admissions Requirements for G30 Undergraduate Programs
about: Nagoya University's English-taught G30 undergraduate programmes for October 2027 entry hold a second application round, open 5 January 2027 and closing 21 January 2027 at 12:00 noon JST, for a limited set of programmes. Final decisions are announced 26 April 2027.
requirements: Second round available only for limited programmes; per the English requirements, no second round for Chemistry (Science), Biological Science, Social Sciences and Japan-in-Asia Cultural Studies
Primary screening results 24 March 2027; interviews/oral exams 6-16 April 2027
card_alt: EduCut Connect card for the 2027 Admissions Requirements for G30 Undergraduate Programs at Nagoya University, Nagoya, Japan, with a second-round deadline of 21 Jan 2027. The photo shows Tokyo Tower and the Tokyo skyline at dusk, not Nagoya.
